title: orthocarpus cuspidatus subsp. copelandii
intro: Orthocarpus cuspidatus subsp. copelandii, commonly known as Copeland's beardtongue, is a perennial plant species within the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, as well as therapeutic actions like antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Copeland's beardtongue include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
